tp_search_summary: Grepped the repo (excluding node_modules/.git/target) for 'getCurrent', 'Webview.getCurrent' and bracket-string access. Hits: webview.ts:284/446/464 are JSDoc @example lines; webviewWindow.ts:125 defines WebviewWindow's own static getCurrent (the flagged out-of-index site, which is a definition, not a call); examples/api/src/views/Window.svelte:19 calls WebviewWindow.getCurrent(), which resolves to WebviewWindow's own static method. applyMixins(WebviewWindow, [Window, Webview]) copies only prototype (instance) members, never statics, and WebviewWindow does not extend Webview, so Webview.getCurrent is not reached.
rationale: Static Webview.getCurrent has no in-repo invocation. The one textual out-of-index hit is the definition of a different static method on WebviewWindow. The example app's WebviewWindow.getCurrent() call dispatches to that class's own static, and the mixin copies only prototype members, so nothing reaches Webview's static.
